name: docs-vault
description: Six skills for a project's docs/ Obsidian vault: init bootstraps it, recall reads it, record writes it, todos lists the open work, graph colour-codes the graph view, and preset saves and applies your Obsidian settings. The vault keeps a dated, append-only journal with #decision and #todo tags, and leaves everything else to the project's Conventions.md. Requires kepano/obsidian-skills.
